description: Author-approved, version-controlled policy used by the deterministic validation gate. This file is an initial test policy for the first contract-gate slice. It is not the complete production handoff contract and must not be treated as a full schema for the E Comm worksheet.
scope_notes: Only CustomerID and Churn have blocking rules in this version.
Remaining source columns are not yet constrained; absence of a rule is not approval of those columns.
Canonical category mappings, nullability for other fields, numeric ranges, and model_input_columns remain open (T-02, T-03).
This policy must be updated only by ordinary code review. Crew 1 must not rewrite it to make a generated dataset_contract.json pass.

source.dataset_name: Ecommerce Customer Churn Analysis and Prediction
source.author: Ankit Verma

model_input_columns_note: Empty on purpose in this test policy. CustomerID and Churn are excluded from model inputs; predictor allowlist is not signed off yet (T-03).

CustomerID.rationale: Source identifier on E Comm; records are uniquely keyed by CustomerID (docs/04_DATA_CONTRACT_SPEC.md).

label_meanings.0: recorded non-churn in the historical workbook
label_meanings.1: recorded churn in the historical workbook

unsupported_claims: Churn=1 does not mean abandonment within a documented future time window. Data Dict defines Churn only as Churn Flag.
Churn.rationale: Observed source labels and the selected binary classification problem (docs/01_PROJECT_DEFINITION.md, docs/04_DATA_CONTRACT_SPEC.md).
